study_identification_part.si_4_title: Investigating dopaminergic abnormalities in schizophrenia and first-episode psychosis with normative modelling and multisite molecular neuroimaging

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: This study uses data from multiple imaging sites with no single named public dataset. Specifically: (1) [11C]-(+)-PHNO data from 2 scanners at Invicro, London (PET/CT Siemens Hi-Rez Biograph 6, N=54 HC; PET/MR Siemens Biograph mMR, N=23 HC); (2) [18F]FDOPA data from 5 scanners at 3 imaging sites (MRC Cyclotron Unit London, Invicro London, and Bundang Hospital South Korea). The FDOPA datasets include FDOPA_01 (N=61 HC, 25 patients), FDOPA_02 (N=26 HC, 24 patients), FDOPA_03 (N=12 HC, 24 patients), FDOPA_04 (N=0 HC, 36 patients), FDOPA_HC01 (N=36 HC), and FDOPA_HC02 (N=7 HC). Total: 77 HC for [11C]-(+)-PHNO model; 142 HC for [18F]FDOPA model.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Data from 77 HC (Table 1) from two previous studies [40, 41], acquired with [11C]-(+)-PHNO, were used..."; "6-[18F]fluoro-L-DOPA (FDOPA) data from 142 HC and 109 patients with psychotic disorders from previous studies [7, 13, 14, 42-48] were used for estimating the NM of dopamine synthesis capacity..."; "Data were acquired with five different scanners (Siemens Hi-Rez Biograph 6, Siemens Biograph 40 TruePoint, Siemens TruePoint 6, ECAT HR + 962, and ECAT EXACT 3D) in three different imaging sites (MRC Cyclotron Unit, London; Invicro, London and Bundang Hospital, South Korea)."

answer.[11C]-(+)-PHNO (PET/CT + PET/MR): normative model training (harmonisation method evaluation); the NM was estimated from 77 HC to compare harmonisation strategies

answer.FDOPA_01: normative model training/testing (HC, N=61) and clinical application (patients, N=25 FEP)

answer.FDOPA_02: normative model training/testing (HC, N=26) and clinical application (patients, N=24 chronic SCZ)

answer.FDOPA_03: normative model training/testing (HC, N=12) and clinical application (patients, N=24 chronic SCZ)

answer.FDOPA_04: independent clinical validation cohort (patients only, N=36 mixed FEP+chronic); used to test NM without matched HC

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Two normative models were constructed: (1) [11C]-(+)-PHNO model for D2/3 receptor density using 77 HC from 2 scanners to evaluate harmonisation methods (Combat vs smoothing); (2) [18F]FDOPA model for dopamine synthesis capacity using 142 HC from 5 scanners. The FDOPA NM was then applied to patient cohorts (N=109 total) to investigate deviations from normality, treatment response prediction, and clinical correlations.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "[11C]-(+)-PHNO Datasets. Data from 77 HC (Table 1) from two previous studies [40, 41]... were used to assess and select the best image harmonisation method."; "[18F]FDOPA datasets... were used for estimating the NM of dopamine synthesis capacity and exploration of its alterations in psychosis"; "we used the estimated [18F]FDOPA PET model to calculate the deviations from normality in four datasets [7, 13, 14, 42-48] acquired in patients, one of which did not include any matched HC."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Model-1 ([11C]-(+)-PHNO): 77 HC total from 2 scanners (PET/CT: 54, PET/MR: 23). Model-2 ([18F]FDOPA): 142 HC total from 5 scanners across 3 sites (FDOPA_01: 61, FDOPA_02: 26, FDOPA_03: 12, FDOPA_HC01: 36, FDOPA_HC02: 7). Both models used k-fold cross-validation (k=5) for HC, so explicit train/test splits are not reported.
